```python
# python3 demo_entry_check.py  （仓库根目录执行）
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re

src = Path("index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
chg = Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

# --- 3) 嵌套 <a> 与残留 <a class="work*"> ---
class A(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True); self.d=0; self.nested=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == "a":
            self.d += 1
            if self.d > 1: self.nested.append(dict(attrs))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == "a": self.d = max(0, self.d - 1)
p = A(); p.feed(src)
print("nested <a> count:", len(p.nested), p.nested[:5])
print("residual <a class=work*>:", re.findall(r'<a[^>]*class="[^"]*\bwork[\w-]*[^"]*"[^>]*>', src)[:10])
print("div onclick=showWork count:", len(re.findall(r'onclick="showWork\(', src)))

# --- 1) demo-entry 按钮属性 ---
for b in re.findall(r'<a[^>]*class="[^"]*demo-entry[^"]*"[^>]*>', src):
    print("BTN:", dict(re.findall(r'([\w-]+)="([^"]*)"', b)))
print("demo/*.html hrefs:", sorted(set(re.findall(r'href="(demo/[^"]+)"', src))))

# --- 2) 标签 ---
print("demo-tag 出现:", src.count("demo-tag"), "| research-tag 出现:", src.count("research-tag"))
for m in re.finditer(r'<[^>]*class="[^"]*(?:demo-tag|research-tag)[^"]*"[^>]*>[^<]*', src):
    print("TAG:", m.group(0)[:200])

# --- 4) CSS 与移动端命中区 ---
for sel in (".demo-entry", ".demo-tag", ".research-tag"):
    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(sel) + r'\b[^{]*\{[^}]*\}', src):
        print("CSS:", m.group(0)[:220].replace("\n", " "))
print("min-height:44px 位置:", [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'min-height:\s*44px', src)])
print("media query 位置:", [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'@media', src)])

# --- 5) 版本号 ---
print("index 版本:", re.findall(r'v5\.\d+\.\d+', src)[:5])
print("CHANGELOG 版本:", re.findall(r'v5\.\d+\.\d+', chg)[:5])
```
